comments.value:
This somehow ended back at the top of the trending feature requests. Hi to all the players that have no idea this exists because they didn't bother adding temporary UI for all the config stuff.
They straight up need to move anything from the config file into the new UI.
Yeah, everything in the config file should be a UI ingame. This is a standalone game designed by an actual company, not a damn minecraft mod.

Not only particle limiter is needed in the new gui update, but dynamic bone / cache location / size / screenshot resolutions. 
Way to few know there are options, some turn off dynamic bone limiter cause default is way too low, that's really not recommended.

details: Enable the Particle Limiter by default and made it enable to change the settings ingame and not to restart for changes to happen.
title: Particle Limitier
